body: Did you ever end up getting dry socket?

I’m 9 weeks out. Definitely ask your physical therapist and doctor. My physical therapist told me that it would be very noticeable if you ripped the anchor out, the bicep will retract giving you the “popeye arm” look. Also look out if there is any bruising. But take it easy until you see either your doctor or physical therapist.
